text: Today, many people enjoy shopping on the Internet. They can buy things without going to stores, so online shopping is very convenient. However, some people worry about buying clothes online because they cannot try them on. Some online stores let customers return clothes for free, and in this way they make their customers feel safe.

These days, more and more people are interested in electric cars. Electric cars do not use gasoline, so they are good for the environment. However, charging them takes a long time. Now, some companies are building fast charging stations in many places, and by doing so, they are making electric cars easier to use.

Many towns have volunteer groups that clean parks and streets. Volunteering is a good way to help the community and make new friends. However, some people are too busy to join such activities. Some groups hold short events on weekends, and in this way, they help busy people take part more easily.

In Japan, many people keep pets such as dogs and cats. Pets can make people happy and relaxed. However, taking care of pets costs time and money. Some animal hospitals give owners advice about their pets' health on the Internet, and in this way, they support busy pet owners.

Today, plastic garbage is a big problem around the world. Plastic bags are convenient, but they are bad for the sea and animals. Now, many supermarkets ask customers to bring their own shopping bags, and by doing so, they are trying to reduce plastic garbage.

Eating vegetables is important for our health. However, many young people do not eat enough vegetables because cooking them takes time. These days, some restaurants serve dishes with a lot of local vegetables, and in this way, they help people enjoy healthy meals easily.

Smartphones are useful for students. They can look up information quickly and talk with their friends easily. However, using smartphones too much is bad for their eyes and sleep. Some schools teach students how to use smartphones safely, and in this way, they help students build good habits.

Libraries are popular places for many people. People can read books and study there for free. Recently, some libraries have started to open cafes inside, and by doing so, they are trying to attract more visitors, especially young people.

There are many convenience stores in Japan, and they are open for long hours. People can buy food and drinks there at any time. Also, some convenience stores sell fresh vegetables from local farms, and in this way, they attract customers who care about their health.

Many people in Japan travel by train. Trains usually come on time, so people can plan their trips easily. These days, some train companies sell special tickets with discounts for tourists, and by doing so, they encourage more people to enjoy traveling by train.

In Japan, most junior high school students wear school uniforms. Uniforms are useful because students do not have to choose clothes every morning. However, buying uniforms costs a lot of money. Now, some schools collect old uniforms from graduates and give them to new students, and in this way, they help families save money.

Walking is one of the easiest ways to stay healthy. People do not need any special equipment, and they can start at any time. Recently, some cities have made beautiful walking courses along rivers, and in this way, they encourage people to walk more in their daily lives.

Every year, many foreign tourists visit Japan. They enjoy Japanese food, temples, and beautiful nature. However, some tourists have trouble because they cannot read Japanese signs. Now, many towns put signs in several languages, and by doing so, they help foreign visitors travel more easily.

These days, many people study online. They can take lessons at home, so they do not need to spend time going to school. Also, some websites let students watch the same lesson many times, and in this way, they help students understand difficult points at their own pace.

Summer festivals are popular events in Japan. People enjoy watching fireworks and eating food at the stalls. However, some small towns cannot hold festivals because they do not have enough money. Some towns ask local companies for help, and in this way, they keep their traditional events alive.

Bicycles are useful for short trips. They do not need gasoline, and riding them is good exercise. In some cities, people can borrow bicycles at stations for a small fee. In this way, the cities help people move around town without using cars.

Many high school students in Japan have part-time jobs. They can earn money and learn how to work with other people. However, some students become too tired to study. Some shops let students choose their working days freely, and in this way, they help students keep a good balance.

Recycling is important for protecting the environment. People can turn old paper and cans into new products. However, some people do not know how to separate their garbage. Now, some cities send guidebooks with pictures to every home, and by doing so, they make recycling easier for everyone.

Music is a part of daily life for many people. They listen to music while they are working or relaxing. Some music schools now offer online lessons for beginners, and in this way, they give more people a chance to start playing an instrument.

Cooking at home is becoming popular again. Home-cooked meals are usually cheaper and healthier than eating out. However, some people think cooking takes too much time. Some websites show short videos of easy recipes, and in this way, they help busy people cook at home.

City parks are important places for people living in towns. People can relax, exercise, and meet their neighbors there. However, some parks are not safe at night. Some cities have put more lights along the paths, and in this way, they help people use parks safely.

Japan has many earthquakes and typhoons every year. It is important for people to prepare for these disasters. Now, many cities hold training events for local people, and in this way, they help everyone learn what to do in an emergency.

Taking photos has become very easy because of smartphones. People take pictures of food, flowers, and their friends every day. However, some people take photos in places where it is not allowed. Some museums put clear signs at the entrance, and in this way, they tell visitors where they can take pictures.

Reading books helps people learn new things and understand other people's feelings. However, young people today read fewer books than before because they spend more time on the Internet. Some schools give students ten minutes to read every morning, and in this way, they help students build a reading habit.

More and more people in Japan pay without cash. They use credit cards or smartphone apps at stores. Paying without cash is fast, but some older people find it difficult. Some shops keep both cash and cashless systems, and in this way, they make shopping easy for all customers.

Health checkups help people find health problems early. Doctors say that finding a problem early makes treatment easier. However, some people are too busy to visit hospitals. Now, some companies bring checkup buses to their offices, and in this way, they help their workers stay healthy.

Moving to a new house is exciting, but it is also hard work. People need to pack many things and clean their old house. Some moving companies offer boxes and packing help for free, and in this way, they reduce the stress of moving.

New Year is the most important holiday in Japan. Families get together, eat special food, and visit shrines. However, preparing New Year's food takes a lot of time. Now, many stores sell ready-made New Year's dishes, and in this way, they help families enjoy the holiday more easily.

Many people enjoy watching sports on TV or at stadiums. Watching a game with other fans is exciting. However, tickets for popular games are often expensive. Some teams sell cheaper tickets for children and their families, and in this way, they help more young fans come to the stadium.

Zoos and aquariums are popular places for families. Children can see animals that they cannot see in daily life. Also, some zoos teach visitors about protecting wild animals, and in this way, they help people think about nature.

Buying used things is becoming popular in Japan. People can get books, clothes, and furniture at low prices. Also, using things again is good for the environment. Some websites check the quality of used items before selling them, and in this way, they help buyers feel safe.

Buying food made in your own area is good for both farmers and customers. The food is fresh, and it does not travel a long way. Some supermarkets put the farmer's name and photo on each package, and in this way, they help customers feel closer to the people who grow their food.
